create_enum_factor: create an EnumFactor with valid configurations and log potentials for probabilistic inference
build_enum_wiring: build an EnumWiring by compiling factor edges, variables, and configurations for belief propagation
concatenate_enum_wirings: concatenate a list of EnumWirings into a single combined wiring for multiple factor groups
compute_enum_energy: compute the energy contribution of several EnumFactors given edge states and log potentials
pass_enum_messages: pass factor-to-variable messages from EnumFactors using sum-product or max-product belief propagation
